The '''Caves of Light and Shadow''' were the site of an old [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. The caves became a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], where the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] and [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] energies in the caves were unbalanced. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strong enough to resist the dark side studied the balance of the Force in the caves, and after the fall of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] the dark side power increased. The caves were lit by crystals embedded in the walls. These [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] could also be used in the construction of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="LotL" />

The dark side was strong enough in the caves to corrupt the local [[Icewolf|icewolves]].<ref name="LotL" />
